The trace also shows failed/not-found/404 states for Freenet Flex rather than a completed extraction, so the final artifact is not complete or fully evidence-backed.

interpretation: All eight worker-returned JavaScript failures retain target metadata; the killed worker supplies no result. The four ordinary action/DOM errors have retained evaluator captures.

The six nonprimary observations occur where tabs.open/get had attached or attempted a different page before rejecting, so assignment to global page did not finish. Two later browser-free/list cells retain that last observation. Different primary and observation IDs are expected, not evidence of wrong routing.
All six nonprimary observer captures timed out. This run exercises target routing metadata but does not remotely validate pixels from a nonprimary tab. Local real-Chrome tests cover those pixels.
No failed cell in this run captured a native image before throwing. Local real-Pi and HTTP Responses transport tests cover image preservation; this remote run does not.
Four CDP-failed cells and two following list/data-only cells account for six observer protocol timeouts. The trace does not identify whether renderer, provider or resource pressure caused them.
The tab inventory at event 211 contains 22 pages after speculative URL opens. Resource pressure is plausible but unmeasured; do not call it the root cause.

The worker timeout at event 251 follows a five-URL loop and is contained. The model then delivers through finish without further JavaScript or replay. Existing in-memory records are lost, while transcript and captured files remain.

confirmed_incomplete: Three Freenet Flex rows have null price, data, network, contract and source; observed paths include not-found pages. Their unavailability everywhere is not established.
Vodafone 280 GB has no price. Event 159 lists it in overview text; event 171 shows an active Young configurator with 20 GB, 100 GB and unlimited. The requested complete row was not acquired.
Vodafone 10 GB is replaced by an explicitly labeled observed 25 GB tier. This is not an exact requested-tier result.
judge_nuance: Vodafone event 155 actually displays 35 GB instead of 30 GB, and Otelo event 183 displays a 125 GB offer. The final acknowledges those live variants. Their mismatch with requested tiers is not by itself evidence of fabricated observations.

The final Otelo phrase identifying 125 GB as a promotion from 100 GB is not verified by the retained 125 GB card. The same page has a separate 200 GB instead of 100 GB statement for Unlimited on Demand. Do not silently transfer that statement to another plan.
The actual Laith failure and score zero remain unchanged; this audit neither rejudges nor asserts that the entire final output is correct.
delivery.recovery_evidence: Event 231 retains checked radio states; event 235 misses the 100 GB label because it starts with Beliebt, then event 239 successfully uses includes and extracts the matching selected price. Self-repair works in that observed sequence.
